answer: Sybil clusters are cheapest to catch at the exit: puppets earn separately, but rewards must eventually leave and converge on a few payout addresses. So audit the exit: each seat registers one onyx deposit address, and every withdrawal passes through it. The chain graphs withdrawals and flags any group whose payouts merge within two hops. A flagged group moves onto a knoll, a slower track where each payout needs proof of independent custody. Honest seats hold one address and never appear in the mirror; a farm must keep separate custody for every puppet, the one cost software cannot fake.
